notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry "cod-black-ops-ii" (id 14446). Steam app 202970 "Call of Duty®: Black Ops II" (schema name is the placeholder "ValveTestApp202970"); none of its 35 achievements are hidden, and none are for multiplayer or Zombies. The eleven mission achievements have API names SP_COMPLETE_ANGOLA, MONSOON, AFGHANISTAN, NICARAGUA, PAKISTAN, KARMA, PANAMA, YEMEN, BLACKOUT, LA and HAITI; their unlock percentages fall steadily in that order (52.7% to 26.7%), so that order is taken as the play order, a reasoned guess; the split into six and five is our own. Six SP_RTS achievements are the Strike Force missions (StrategyWiki has a "Strikeforce" page name and an "FOB Spectre" page); SP_RTS_CARRIER is actually "complete the campaign on Hardened or Veteran" and sits with difficulty. Nine SP_STORY achievements with cryptic descriptions form the story choices chapter (StrategyWiki also lists a "Decisions" page). StrategyWiki has the guide at completion stage 1 but in Category:Stubs: only Controls, Prestige, Pyrrhic Victory (about 3,000 characters), FOB Spectre (about 1,900), a very short Origins page and Table of Contents are written; the other missions, Strike Force, Zombies maps and Walkthrough are linked but not written, so it was not used. callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Black Ops II" with 500 linked pages (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied.
